question: What is the area of the segment formed by a chord in a circle of radius 6 cm, if the angle subtended at the center is 120°?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of a circular segment = r² × [πθ/360° − sin(θ)/2]

⇒ Area = 6² × [120π/360 − sin(120°)/2]

⇒ Area = 36 × [π/3 − √3/4]

⇒ Area = 12π − 9√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 12π−9√3 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the circle (r) = 6 cm

Angle subtended at the center (θ) = 120°
